title: House Building Finance Corporation Repeal Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: House Building Finance Corporation Repeal Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXV OF 2018
ACT XXV OF 2018
HOUSE BUILDING FINANCE CORPORATION (REPEAL) ACT,
2018
An Act to repeal the House Building Finance
Corporation Act, 1952
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
24th May, 2018]
No.
F. 9(8)/2018-Legis, dated 22.5.2018.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 18th May, 2018 and is hereby published for general
information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the House Building Finance Corporation Act, 1952
(XVIII of 1952), for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It is hereby enacted as
follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the House Building Finance Corporation (Repeal) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
